name: Kerjaya Prospek Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团在 Properties 板块完成对 Tanjung Bungah Development 剩余40%股权的收购并终止相关合资协议，同时通过子公司投资 Aspen Vision Land 49%股权；在 Others 板块通过 Acumen 分步增持 ES Sunlogy Berhad 至约31%股权。Construction 板块获得分包合约，并与 Railway Assets Corporation 就土地开发协议多次延长期限。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group completed the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development and terminated the related joint venture agreements under the Properties segment, while investing in 49% equity interest of Aspen Vision Land via a subsidiary. Under the Others segment, the Group via Acumen progressively increased its stake in ES Sunlogy Berhad to approximately 31%.

segments.name: 建筑
segments.note: 今年获得分包工程合约，并与 Railway Assets Corporation 就土地开发协议多次延长期限。
segments.note_en: Secured sub-contract works this year and extended the agreement period with Railway Assets Corporation for a land development project multiple times.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. 将总额 RM25,067,486.00 的两份分包合约授予 Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. awarded two sub-contracts totalling RM25,067,486.00 to Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将签署最终协议的期限延长至2026年6月30日。
actions.text_en: The parties mutually agreed to extend the deadline for executing the Definitive Agreement to 30 June 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方同意将签署最终协议的期限进一步延长至2026年5月31日。
actions.text_en: The parties mutually agreed to further extend the deadline for executing the Definitive Agreement to 31 May 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 与 Railway Assets Corporation 同意将签署最终协议的期限延长至2026年4月30日。
actions.text_en: Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd. and Railway Assets Corporation mutually agreed to extend the deadline for executing the Definitive Agreement to 30 April 2026.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年完成对 Tanjung Bungah Development 剩余40%股权的收购并终止相关合资协议，同时投资 Aspen Vision Land 49%股权。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development and terminated the related joint venture agreements, while investing in 49% equity interest of Aspen Vision…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述收购及终止协议的先决条件已满足并完成。
actions.text_en: The conditions precedent for the acquisition and termination of the agreements were fulfilled and the acquisition was completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 拟收购 Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd. 剩余40%股权，并终止相关合资协议及认购与股东协议。
actions.text_en: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. proposed to acquire the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd. and terminate the related joint venture and share subscription and shareholders' agreements.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 完成认购 Aspen Vision Land Sdn. Bhd. 新股份。
actions.text_en: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. completed the subscription of new shares in Aspen Vision Land Sdn. Bhd., holding a 49% equity interest.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方确认合资协议及认购与股东协议的所有先决条件已满足，协议成为无条件。
actions.text_en: The parties confirmed that all conditions precedent to the joint venture and share subscription and shareholders' agreements were fulfilled, and the agreements became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 与 Aspen Vision Tanjung Sdn. Bhd. 同意将合资协议及认购与股东协议的条件满足期限延长至2026年2月28日。
actions.text_en: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. and Aspen Vision Tanjung Sdn. Bhd. agreed to extend the deadline for fulfilling conditions precedent under the joint venture and share subscription and shareholders' agreements to 28 February 2026.

segments.name: 其他
segments.note: 今年通过 Acumen 分步增持 ES Sunlogy Berhad 股权至约31%。
segments.note_en: Progressively increased its stake in ES Sunlogy Berhad to approximately 31% via Acumen this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Acumen 通过直接商业交易进一步收购 ES Sunlogy Berhad 额外2.73%股权。
actions.text_en: Acumen further acquired an additional 2.73% equity interest in ES Sunlogy Berhad through direct business transactions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Acumen 以每股平均 RM0.272 收购 ES Sunlogy Berhad 额外147,700,000股普通股，占19.18%股权。
actions.text_en: Acumen acquired an additional 147,700,000 ordinary shares in ES Sunlogy Berhad, representing 19.18% equity interest, at an average price of RM0.272 per share.
